breaking_news.headline: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards

breaking_news.summary: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

breaking_news.headline: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
breaking_news.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

breaking_news.headline: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
breaking_news.summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

breaking_news.headline: Egg prices have tumbled since Trump returned to office. Here's why
breaking_news.summary: Agriculture experts say high egg prices were the result of severe avian flu outbreaks, but the Trump administration's tariffs and the war with Iran have also put pressure on farmers.

breaking_news.headline: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
breaking_news.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

breaking_news.headline: Breweries adapt as tastes in beer change
breaking_news.summary: The craft beer market is saturated and tastes are changing. Brewers are coming with innovative ways to attract customers.

breaking_news.headline: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
breaking_news.summary: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.

breaking_news.headline: Trump's AI rebrand causes 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names
breaking_news.summary: The president wants AI to be called super intelligence - or SI - the same initials used by Slovenian domains.

breaking_news.headline: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
breaking_news.summary: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

breaking_news.headline: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
breaking_news.summary: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.

breaking_news.headline: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
breaking_news.summary: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

breaking_news.headline: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
breaking_news.summary: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

breaking_news.headline: What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?

breaking_news.headline: PM warned Rosebank oil field could breach West Bank sanctions
